We currently allow meta posts, news posts, roleplay posts and claim posts on Meta Day (we recently started allowing GDP rolls too). However, the definition of news posts and event posts is causing a slight issue as the difference between the two is pretty vague.

An event post is typically something similar to a news post that requires a roll, but not necessarily. For example, a world leader visiting another country may be considered as an event post if there has already been a diplomacy post in which both players involved agreed to a state visit later in the year. Event posts are things that will affect your country, change your stats or affect another country (more often than not).

News posts are generally less important, such as a festival taking place in your country or some kind of parade.

Meta Day is out of game time, as it occurs in between game years. For this reason, any posts that make any real change in your country or somebody else's country will not be allowed (apart from GDP rolls). This includes any diplomacy, events, conflicts, expansions etc. Making a post that affects your country in a way that should not be happening outside of game time will be invalidated, even if it is tagged as a news post or roleplay post.
